name: 賞与 (bonus)
authority: 健康保険法 §3(6), 厚生年金保険法 §3(1)(iv) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/211AC0000000070; https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/329AC0000000115): a payment for labour, whatever its name, made three or fewer times a year is a 賞与; its 標準賞与額 bears health, care, pension and support premiums. A payment made four or more times a year is remuneration and belongs in the monthly grade instead. 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 §2(2) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/344AC0000000084): 賞与 is 賃金, so it also bears 雇用保険 and 労災保険 at its payment. 所得税法 §186 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033): a 賞与 is withheld by the bonus rate table (INCOME_TAX_BONUS), not the monthly table.

name: 食事の現物支給 (meals provided, monthly value)
authority: 所得税法 §36; 所得税基本通達 36-38の2 (https://www.nta.go.jp/users/gensen/2026shokuji/index.htm; https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2594.htm): the month’s value (before consumption tax) of meals the employer provides. INCOME_TAX leaves it untaxed where the worker pays at least half (MEAL_CHARGE) and the value less the charge is at most JPY3,500 (JPY7,500 for meals provided from 1 April 2026); otherwise the value less the charge is pay. Destination DISPLAY: never paid. The 社会保険・労働保険 in-kind valuation (告示 prices) is not this entry.

name: 食事代の本人負担 (worker’s meal charge)
authority: 所得税基本通達 36-38の2 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2594.htm): the worker’s own payment for the meals of MEAL_IN_KIND, deducted from net pay. It is not pay.

name: 退職手当 (retirement allowance)
authority: 所得税法 §30(1) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033): 退職手当、一時恩給その他の退職により一時に受ける給与 — taxed apart as 退職所得 (RETIREMENT_INCOME_TAX) and by the 退職所得割 (RESIDENT_TAX_RETIREMENT, 地方税法 §50-2, §328); it may fund an exit lump collection of the monthly resident tax (地方税法 §321-5(2)). It is not wages for the monthly withholding table, and not 報酬 or 賞与 (健康保険法 §3(5)–(6), https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/211AC0000000070; 厚生年金保険法 §3(1)(iii)–(iv), https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/329AC0000000115) nor 賃金 for 労働保険 (徴収法 §2(2), https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/344AC0000000084): recorded default, a payment by reason of retirement rather than for a period’s labour. Record the exit (last day and exit facts) first.

name: 休業手当 (shutdown allowance)
authority: 労働基準法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049) §26: for a shutdown attributable to the employer, at least 60% of the 平均賃金 for each day of it; where part of a day was worked and paid, the difference up to that 60%. 平均賃金 (労働基準法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049) §12): the wages of the three calendar months before the event’s month over their calendar days, the §12(3) maternity, childcare and family-care leave spans and their wages left out; bonuses and one-off pay are not in the wage total (§12(4)). Kanagawa Labour Bureau (https://jsite.mhlw.go.jp/kanagawa-roudoukyoku/hourei_seido_tetsuzuki/saiteichingin_chinginseido/heikinchi.html): the average drops the fraction below one sen; the payment rounds to the yen, 50 sen and over up. Where the payslips cannot state it — the §12(1) 60% floor for day, hour or piece pay, a trial period, a work-injury or earlier shutdown period, a closing day other than month end, under three months’ service — the request records the computed 平均賃金 as average_wage. The allowance is 賃金: it bears 雇用保険 and 労災保険 (Kanagawa Labour Bureau 労働保険料の算定基礎となる賃金早見表 (https://jsite.mhlw.go.jp/kanagawa-roudoukyoku/hourei_seido_tetsuzuki/roudou_hoken/hourei_seido/rouho_hayami.html)) and is 給与 for 所得税法 §28(1) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033). An agreed amount above the floor (entry.amount) stands.

name: 解雇予告手当 (pay in lieu of dismissal notice)
authority: 労働基準法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049) §20(1)–(2): a dismissal needs 30 days’ notice or 30 days’ 平均賃金, the notice shortened by a day for each day’s 平均賃金 paid — (30 − the notice days given) × the average; §20(1) ただし書 and §21 exemptions (inspector-certified disaster or worker fault; day hires, short fixed terms, seasonal work, probation within 14 days) are HR’s decision not to raise the request. 平均賃金 (労働基準法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049) §12): the wages of the three calendar months before the event’s month over their calendar days, the §12(3) maternity, childcare and family-care leave spans and their wages left out; bonuses and one-off pay are not in the wage total (§12(4)). Kanagawa Labour Bureau (https://jsite.mhlw.go.jp/kanagawa-roudoukyoku/hourei_seido_tetsuzuki/saiteichingin_chinginseido/heikinchi.html): the average drops the fraction below one sen; the payment rounds to the yen, 50 sen and over up. Where the payslips cannot state it — the §12(1) 60% floor for day, hour or piece pay, a trial period, a work-injury or earlier shutdown period, a closing day other than month end, under three months’ service — the request records the computed 平均賃金 as average_wage. The allowance is not 賃金 for labour insurance (Kanagawa Labour Bureau 労働保険料の算定基礎となる賃金早見表 (https://jsite.mhlw.go.jp/kanagawa-roudoukyoku/hourei_seido_tetsuzuki/roudou_hoken/hourei_seido/rouho_hayami.html)) and is a 退職手当等 for income tax (所得税基本通達 30-5, https://www.nta.go.jp/law/tsutatsu/kihon/shotoku/04/04.htm), so it counts as the RETIREMENT_ALLOWANCE does. An agreed amount above the floor (entry.amount) stands.

request_facts.description: 労働基準法 §20: the days from the day after notice to the dismissal day (民法 §140, the first day not counted); 0 is dismissal without notice.

request_facts.description: 労働基準法 §12: the daily average wage computed by the employer where the payslips cannot state it; empty reads the three months of payslips.

name: 賞与 (bonus)
authority: 健康保険法 §3(6), 厚生年金保険法 §3(1)(iv) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/211AC0000000070; https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/329AC0000000115): a payment for labour, whatever its name, made three or fewer times a year is a 賞与; its 標準賞与額 bears health, care, pension and support premiums. A payment made four or more times a year is remuneration and belongs in the monthly grade instead. 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 §2(2) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/344AC0000000084): 賞与 is 賃金, so it also bears 雇用保険 and 労災保険 at its payment. 所得税法 §186 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033): a 賞与 is withheld by the bonus rate table (INCOME_TAX_BONUS), not the monthly table.

name: 食事の現物支給 (meals provided, monthly value)
authority: 所得税法 §36; 所得税基本通達 36-38の2 (https://www.nta.go.jp/users/gensen/2026shokuji/index.htm; https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2594.htm): the month’s value (before consumption tax) of meals the employer provides. INCOME_TAX leaves it untaxed where the worker pays at least half (MEAL_CHARGE) and the value less the charge is at most JPY3,500 (JPY7,500 for meals provided from 1 April 2026); otherwise the value less the charge is pay. INCOME_TAX leaves it untaxed where the worker pays at least half (MEAL_CHARGE) and the value less the charge is at most JPY3,500 (JPY7,500 for meals provided from 1 April 2026); otherwise the value less the charge is pay. Destination DISPLAY: never paid. The 社会保険・労働保険 in-kind valuation (告示 prices) is not this entry.

name: 食事代の本人負担 (worker’s meal charge)
authority: 所得税基本通達 36-38の2 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2594.htm): the worker’s own payment for the meals of MEAL_IN_KIND, deducted from net pay. It is not pay.

name: 退職手当 (retirement allowance)
authority: 所得税法 §30(1) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033): 退職手当、一時恩給その他の退職により一時に受ける給与 — taxed apart as 退職所得 (RETIREMENT_INCOME_TAX) and by the 退職所得割 (RESIDENT_TAX_RETIREMENT, 地方税法 §50-2, §328); it may fund an exit lump collection of the monthly resident tax (地方税法 §321-5(2)). It is not wages for the monthly withholding table, and not 報酬 or 賞与 (健康保険法 §3(5)–(6), https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/211AC0000000070; 厚生年金保険法 §3(1)(iii)–(iv), https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/329AC0000000115) nor 賃金 for 労働保険 (徴収法 §2(2), https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/344AC0000000084): recorded default, a payment by reason of retirement rather than for a period’s labour. Record the exit (last day and exit facts) first.

name: 休業手当 (shutdown allowance)
authority: 労働基準法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049) §26: for a shutdown attributable to the employer, at least 60% of the 平均賃金 for each day of it; where part of a day was worked and paid, the difference up to that 60%. 平均賃金 (労働基準法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049) §12): the wages of the three calendar months before the event’s month over their calendar days, the §12(3) maternity, childcare and family-care leave spans and their wages left out; bonuses and one-off pay are not in the wage total (§12(4)). Kanagawa Labour Bureau (https://jsite.mhlw.go.jp/kanagawa-roudoukyoku/hourei_seido_tetsuzuki/saiteichingin_chinginseido/heikinchi.html): the average drops the fraction below one sen; the payment rounds to the yen, 50 sen and over up. Where the payslips cannot state it — the §12(1) 60% floor for day, hour or piece pay, a trial period, a work-injury or earlier shutdown period, a closing day other than month end, under three months’ service — the request records the computed 平均賃金 as average_wage. The allowance is 賃金: it bears 雇用保険 and 労災保険 (Kanagawa Labour Bureau 労働保険料の算定基礎となる賃金早見表 (https://jsite.mhlw.go.jp/kanagawa-roudoukyoku/hourei_seido_tetsuzuki/roudou_hoken/hourei_seido/rouho_hayami.html)) and is 給与 for 所得税法 §28(1) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033). An agreed amount above the floor (entry.amount) stands.

name: 解雇予告手当 (pay in lieu of dismissal notice)
authority: 労働基準法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049) §20(1)–(2): a dismissal needs 30 days’ notice or 30 days’ 平均賃金, the notice shortened by a day for each day’s 平均賃金 paid — (30 − the notice days given) × the average; §20(1) ただし書 and §21 exemptions (inspector-certified disaster or worker fault; day hires, short fixed terms, seasonal work, probation within 14 days) are HR’s decision not to raise the request. 平均賃金 (労働基準法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049) §12): the wages of the three calendar months before the event’s month over their calendar days, the §12(3) maternity, childcare and family-care leave spans and their wages left out; bonuses and one-off pay are not in the wage total (§12(4)). Kanagawa Labour Bureau (https://jsite.mhlw.go.jp/kanagawa-roudoukyoku/hourei_seido_tetsuzuki/saiteichingin_chinginseido/heikinchi.html): the average drops the fraction below one sen; the payment rounds to the yen, 50 sen and over up. Where the payslips cannot state it — the §12(1) 60% floor for day, hour or piece pay, a trial period, a work-injury or earlier shutdown period, a closing day other than month end, under three months’ service — the request records the computed 平均賃金 as average_wage. The allowance is not 賃金 for labour insurance (Kanagawa Labour Bureau 労働保険料の算定基礎となる賃金早見表 (https://jsite.mhlw.go.jp/kanagawa-roudoukyoku/hourei_seido_tetsuzuki/roudou_hoken/hourei_seido/rouho_hayami.html)) and is a 退職手当等 for income tax (所得税基本通達 30-5, https://www.nta.go.jp/law/tsutatsu/kihon/shotoku/04/04.htm), so it counts as the RETIREMENT_ALLOWANCE does. An agreed amount above the floor (entry.amount) stands.

request_facts.label: 平均賃金 (daily, where recorded)
request_facts.description: 労働基準法 §12: the daily average wage computed by the employer where the payslips cannot state it; empty reads the three months of payslips.

name: 賞与 (bonus)
authority: 健康保険法 §3(6), 厚生年金保険法 §3(1)(iv) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/211AC0000000070; https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/329AC0000000115): a payment for labour, whatever its name, made three or fewer times a year is a 賞与; its 標準賞与額 bears health, care, pension and support premiums. A payment made four or more times a year is remuneration and belongs in the monthly grade instead. 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 §2(2) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/344AC0000000084): 賞与 is 賃金, so it also bears 雇用保険 and 労災保険 at its payment. 所得税法 §186 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033): a 賞与 is withheld by the bonus rate table (INCOME_TAX_BONUS), not the monthly table.

authority: 労働基準法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049) §20(1)–(2): a dismissal needs 30 days’ notice or 30 days’ 平均賃金, the notice shortened by a day for each day’s 平均賃金 paid — (30 − the notice days given) × the average; §20(1) ただし書 and §21 exemptions (inspector-certified disaster or worker fault; day hires, short fixed terms, seasonal work, probation within 14 days) are HR’s decision not to raise the request. 平均賃金 (労働基準法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049) §12): the wages of the three calendar months before the event’s month over their calendar days, the §12(3) maternity, childcare and family-care leave spans and their wages left out; bonuses and one-off pay are not in the wage total (§12(4)). Kanagawa Labour Bureau (https://jsite.mhlw.go.jp/kanagawa-roudoukyoku/hourei_seido_tetsuzuki/saiteichingin_chinginseido/heikinchi.html): the average drops the fraction below one sen; the payment rounds to the yen, 50 sen and over up. Where the payslips cannot state it — the §12(1) 60% floor for day, hour or piece pay, a trial period, a work-injury or earlier shutdown period, a closing day other than month end, under three months’ service — the request records the computed 平均賃金 as average_wage. name: 賞与 (bonus)
authority: 健康保険法 §3(6), 厚生年金保険法 §3(1)(iv) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/211AC0000000070; https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/329AC0000000115): a payment for labour, whatever its name, made three or fewer times a year is a 賞与; its 標準賞与額 bears health, care, pension and support premiums. A payment made four or more times a year is remuneration and belongs in the monthly grade instead. 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 §2(2) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/344AC0000000084): 賞与 is 賃金, so it also bears 雇用保険 and 労災保険 at its payment. 所得税法 §186 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033): a 賞与 is withheld by the bonus rate table (INCOME_TAX_BONUS), not the monthly table.

name: 食事の現物支給 (meals provided, monthly value)
authority: 所得税法 §36; 所得税基本通達 36-38の2 (https://www.nta.go.jp/users/gensen/2026shokuji/index.htm; https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2594.htm): the month’s value (before consumption tax) of meals the employer provides. INCOME_TAX leaves it untaxed where the worker pays at least half (MEAL_CHARGE) and the value less the charge is at most JPY3,500 (JPY7,500 for meals provided from 1 April 2026); otherwise the value less the charge is pay. Destination DISPLAY: never paid. The 社会保険・労働保険 in-kind valuation (告示 prices) is not this entry.

name: 食事代の本人負担 (worker’s meal charge)

authority: 所得税法 §30(1) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033): 退職手当、一時恩給その他の退職により一時に受ける給与 — taxed apart as 退職所得 (RETIREMENT_INCOME_TAX) and by the 退職所得割 (RESIDENT_TAX_RETIREMENT, 地方税法 §50-2, §328); it may fund an exit lump collection of the monthly resident tax (地方税法 §321-5(2)). name: 賞与 (bonus)
authority: 健康保険法 §3(6), 厚生年金保険法 §3(1)(iv) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/211AC0000000070; https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/329AC0000000115): a payment for labour, whatever its name, made three or fewer times a year is a 賞与; its 標準賞与額 bears health, care, pension and support premiums. A payment made four or more times a year is remuneration and belongs in the monthly grade instead. 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 §2(2) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/344AC0000000084): 賞与 is 賃金, so it also bears 雇用保険 and 労災保険 at its payment. 所得税法 §186 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033): a 賞与 is withheld by the bonus rate table (INCOME_TAX_BONUS), not the monthly table.

name: 食事の現物支給 (meals provided, monthly value)
authority: 所得税法 §36; 所得税基本通達 36-38の2 (https://www.nta.go.jp/users/gensen/2026shokuji/index.htm; https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2594.htm): the month’s value (before consumption tax) of meals the employer provides. INCOME_TAX leaves it untaxed where the worker pays at least half (MEAL_CHARGE) and the value less the charge is at most JPY3,500 (JPY7,500 for meals provided from 1 April 2026); otherwise the value less the charge is pay. name: 賞与 (bonus)
authority: 健康保険法 §3(6), 厚生年金保険法 §3(1)(iv) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/211AC0000000070; https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/329AC0000000115): a payment for labour, whatever its name, made three or fewer times a year is a 賞与; its 標準賞与額 bears health, care, pension and support premiums. A payment made four or more times a year is remuneration and belongs in the monthly grade instead. 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 §2(2) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/344AC0000000084): 賞与 is 賃金, so it also bears 雇用保険 and 労災保険 at its payment. 所得税法 §186 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033): a 賞与 is withheld by the bonus rate table (INCOME_TAX_BONUS), not the monthly table.

name: 食事の現物支給 (meals provided, monthly value)
authority: 所得税法 §36; 所得税基本通達 36-38の2 (https://www.nta.go.jp/users/gensen/2026shokuji/index.htm; https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2594.htm): the month’s value (before consumption tax) of meals the employer provides. INCOME_TAX leaves it untaxed where the worker pays at least half (MEAL_CHARGE) and the value less the charge is at most JPY3,500 (JPY7,500 for meals provided from 1 April 2026); otherwise the value less the charge is pay. Destination DISPLAY: never paid. The 社会保険・労働保険 in-kind valuation (告示 prices) is not this entry.

name: 食事代の本人負担 (worker’s meal charge)
authority: 所得税基本通達 36-38の2 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2594.htm): the worker’s own payment for the meals of MEAL_IN_KIND, deducted from net pay. It is not pay.

name: 退職手当 (retirement allowance)
authority: 所得税法 §30(1) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033): 退職手当、一時恩給その他の退職により一時に受ける給与 — taxed apart as 退職所得 (RETIREMENT_INCOME_TAX) and by the 退職所得割 (RESIDENT_TAX_RETIREMENT, 地方税法 §50-2, §328); it may fund an exit lump collection of the monthly resident tax (地方税法 §321-5(2)). It is not wages for the monthly withholding table, and not 報酬 or 賞与 (健康保険法 §3(5)–(6), https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/211AC0000000070; 厚生年金保険法 §3(1)(iii)–(iv), https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/329AC0000000115) nor 賃金 for 労働保険 (徴収法 §2(2), https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/344AC0000000084): recorded default, a payment by reason of retirement rather than for a period’s labour. Record the exit (last day and exit facts) first.

name: 休業手当 (shutdown allowance)
authority: 労働基準法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049) §26: for a shutdown attributable to the employer, at least 60% of the 平均賃金 for each day of it; where part of a day was worked and paid, the difference up to that 60%. 平均賃金 (労働基準法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049) §12): the wages of the three calendar months before the event’s month over their calendar days, the §12(3) maternity, childcare and family-care leave spans and their wages left out; bonuses and one-off pay are not in the wage total (§12(4)). Kanagawa Labour Bureau (https://jsite.mhlw.go.jp/kanagawa-roudoukyoku/hourei_seido_tetsuzuki/saiteichingin_chinginseido/heikinchi.html): the average drops the fraction below one sen; the payment rounds to the yen, 50 sen and over up. Where the payslips cannot state it — the §12(1) 60% floor for day, hour or piece pay, a trial period, a work-injury or earlier shutdown period, a closing day other than month end, under three months’ service — the request records the computed 平均賃金 as average_wage. The allowance is 賃金: it bears 雇用保険 and 労災保険 (Kanagawa Labour Bureau 労働保険料の算定基礎となる賃金早見表 (https://jsite.mhlw.go.jp/kanagawa-roudoukyoku/hourei_seido_tetsuzuki/roudou_hoken/hourei_seido/rouho_hayami.html)) and is 給与 for 所得税法 §28(1) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033). An agreed amount above the floor (entry.amount) stands.

name: 解雇予告手当 (pay in lieu of dismissal notice)
authority: 労働基準法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049) §20(1)–(2): a dismissal needs 30 days’ notice or 30 days’ 平均賃金, the notice shortened by a day for each day’s 平均賃金 paid — (30 − the notice days given) × the average; §20(1) ただし書 and §21 exemptions (inspector-certified disaster or worker fault; day hires, short fixed terms, seasonal work, probation within 14 days) are HR’s decision not to raise the request. 平均賃金 (労働基準法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049) §12): the wages of the three calendar months before the event’s month over their calendar days, the §12(3) maternity, childcare and family-care leave spans and their wages left out; bonuses and one-off pay are not in the wage total (§12(4)). Where the payslips cannot state it — the §12(1) 60% floor for day, hour or piece pay, a trial period, a work-injury or earlier shutdown period, a closing day other than month end, under three months’ service — the request records the computed 平均賃金 as average_wage. The allowance is not 賃金 for labour insurance (Kanagawa Labour Bureau 労働保険料の算定基礎となる賃金早見表 (https://jsite.mhlw.go.jp/kanagawa-roudoukyoku/hourei_seido_tetsuzuki/roudou_hoken/hourei_seido/rouho_hayami.html)) and is a 退職手当等 for income tax (所得税基本通達 30-5, https://www.nta.go.jp/law/tsutatsu/kihon/shotoku/04/04.htm), so it counts as the RETIREMENT_ALLOWANCE does. name: 賞与 (bonus)
authority: 健康保険法 §3(6), 厚生年金保険法 §3(1)(iv) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/211AC0000000070; https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/329AC0000000115): a payment for labour, whatever its name, made three or fewer times a year is a 賞与; its 標準賞与額 bears health, care, pension and support premiums. A payment made four or more times a year is remuneration and belongs in the monthly grade instead. 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 §2(2) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/344AC0000000084): 賞与 is 賃金, so it also bears 雇用保険 and 労災保険 at its payment. 所得税法 §186 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033): a 賞与 is withheld by the bonus rate table (INCOME_TAX_BONUS), not the monthly table.

name: 食事の現物支給 (meals provided, monthly value)
authority: 所得税法 §36; 所得税基本通達 36-38の2 (https://www.nta.go.jp/users/gensen/2026shokuji/index.htm; https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2594.htm): the month’s value (before consumption tax) of meals the employer provides. INCOME_TAX leaves it untaxed where the worker pays at least half (MEAL_CHARGE) and the value less the charge is at most JPY3,500 (JPY7,500 for meals provided from 1 April 2026); otherwise the value less the charge is pay. INCOME_TAX leaves it untaxed where the worker pays at least half (MEAL_CHARGE) and the value less the charge is at most JPY3,500 (JPY7,500 for meals provided from 1 April 2026); otherwise the value less the charge is pay. Destination DISPLAY: never paid. The 社会保険・労働保険 in-kind valuation (告示 prices) is not this entry.

name: 食事代の本人負担 (worker’s meal charge)
authority: 所得税基本通達 36-38の2 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2594.htm): the worker’s own payment for the meals of MEAL_IN_KIND, deducted from net pay. It is not pay.

name: 退職手当 (retirement allowance)
authority: 所得税法 §30(1) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033): 退職手当、一時恩給その他の退職により一時に受ける給与 — taxed apart as 退職所得 (RETIREMENT_INCOME_TAX) and by the 退職所得割 (RESIDENT_TAX_RETIREMENT, 地方税法 §50-2, §328); it may fund an exit lump collection of the monthly resident tax (地方税法 §321-5(2)). It is not wages for the monthly withholding table, and not 報酬 or 賞与 (健康保険法 §3(5)–(6), https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/211AC0000000070; 厚生年金保険法 §3(1)(iii)–(iv), https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/329AC0000000115) nor 賃金 for 労働保険 (徴収法 §2(2), https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/344AC0000000084): recorded default, a payment by reason of retirement rather than for a period’s labour. Record the exit (last day and exit facts) first.

name: 休業手当 (shutdown allowance)
authority: 労働基準法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049) §26: for a shutdown attributable to the employer, at least 60% of the 平均賃金 for each day of it; where part of a day was worked and paid, the difference up to that 60%. 平均賃金 (労働基準法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049) §12): the wages of the three calendar months before the event’s month over their calendar days, the §12(3) maternity, childcare and family-care leave spans and their wages left out; bonuses and one-off pay are not in the wage total (§12(4)). Kanagawa Labour Bureau (https://jsite.mhlw.go.jp/kanagawa-roudoukyoku/hourei_seido_tetsuzuki/saiteichingin_chinginseido/heikinchi.html): the average drops the fraction below one sen; the payment rounds to the yen, 50 sen and over up. Where the payslips cannot state it — the §12(1) 60% floor for day, hour or piece pay, a trial period, a work-injury or earlier shutdown period, a closing day other than month end, under three months’ service — the request records the computed 平均賃金 as average_wage. The allowance is 賃金: it bears 雇用保険 and 労災保険 (Kanagawa Labour Bureau 労働保険料の算定基礎となる賃金早見表 (https://jsite.mhlw.go.jp/kanagawa-roudoukyoku/hourei_seido_tetsuzuki/roudou_hoken/hourei_seido/rouho_hayami.html)) and is 給与 for 所得税法 §28(1) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033). An agreed amount above the floor (entry.amount) stands.

name: 解雇予告手当 (pay in lieu of dismissal notice)
authority: 労働基準法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049) §20(1)–(2): a dismissal needs 30 days’ notice or 30 days’ 平均賃金, the notice shortened by a day for each day’s 平均賃金 paid — (30 − the notice days given) × the average; §20(1) ただし書 and §21 exemptions (inspector-certified disaster or worker fault; day hires, short fixed terms, seasonal work, probation within 14 days) are HR’s decision not to raise the request. 平均賃金 (労働基準法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049) §12): the wages of the three calendar months before the event’s month over their calendar days, the §12(3) maternity, childcare and family-care leave spans and their wages left out; bonuses and one-off pay are not in the wage total (§12(4)). Kanagawa Labour Bureau (https://jsite.mhlw.go.jp/kanagawa-roudoukyoku/hourei_seido_tetsuzuki/saiteichingin_chinginseido/heikinchi.html): the average drops the fraction below one sen; the payment rounds to the yen, 50 sen and over up. Where the payslips cannot state it — the §12(1) 60% floor for day, hour or piece pay, a trial period, a work-injury or earlier shutdown period, a closing day other than month end, under three months’ service — the request records the computed 平均賃金 as average_wage. The allowance is not 賃金 for labour insurance (Kanagawa Labour Bureau 労働保険料の算定基礎となる賃金早見表 (https://jsite.mhlw.go.jp/kanagawa-roudoukyoku/hourei_seido_tetsuzuki/roudou_hoken/hourei_seido/rouho_hayami.html)) and is a 退職手当等 for income tax (所得税基本通達 30-5, https://www.nta.go.jp/law/tsutatsu/kihon/shotoku/04/04.htm), so it counts as the RETIREMENT_ALLOWANCE does. An agreed amount above the floor (entry.amount) stands.

request_facts.label: 平均賃金 (daily, where recorded)
request_facts.description: 労働基準法 §12: the daily average wage computed by the employer where the payslips cannot state it; empty reads the three months of payslips.

name: 賞与 (bonus)
authority: 健康保険法 §3(6), 厚生年金保険法 §3(1)(iv) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/211AC0000000070; https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/329AC0000000115): a payment for labour, whatever its name, made three or fewer times a year is a 賞与; its 標準賞与額 bears health, care, pension and support premiums. A payment made four or more times a year is remuneration and belongs in the monthly grade instead. 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 §2(2) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/344AC0000000084): 賞与 is 賃金, so it also bears 雇用保険 and 労災保険 at its payment. 所得税法 §186 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033): a 賞与 is withheld by the bonus rate table (INCOME_TAX_BONUS), not the monthly table.

authority: 労働基準法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049) §20(1)–(2): a dismissal needs 30 days’ notice or 30 days’ 平均賃金, the notice shortened by a day for each day’s 平均賃金 paid — (30 − the notice days given) × the average; §20(1) ただし書 and §21 exemptions (inspector-certified disaster or worker fault; day hires, short fixed terms, seasonal work, probation within 14 days) are HR’s decision not to raise the request. 平均賃金 (労働基準法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049) §12): the wages of the three calendar months before the event’s month over their calendar days, the §12(3) maternity, childcare and family-care leave spans and their wages left out; bonuses and one-off pay are not in the wage total (§12(4)). Kanagawa Labour Bureau (https://jsite.mhlw.go.jp/kanagawa-roudoukyoku/hourei_seido_tetsuzuki/saiteichingin_chinginseido/heikinchi.html): the average drops the fraction below one sen; the payment rounds to the yen, 50 sen and over up. Where the payslips cannot state it — the §12(1) 60% floor for day, hour or piece pay, a trial period, a work-injury or earlier shutdown period, a closing day other than month end, under three months’ service — the request records the computed 平均賃金 as average_wage. name: 賞与 (bonus)
authority: 健康保険法 §3(6), 厚生年金保険法 §3(1)(iv) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/211AC0000000070; https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/329AC0000000115): a payment for labour, whatever its name, made three or fewer times a year is a 賞与; its 標準賞与額 bears health, care, pension and support premiums. A payment made four or more times a year is remuneration and belongs in the monthly grade instead. 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 §2(2) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/344AC0000000084): 賞与 is 賃金, so it also bears 雇用保険 and 労災保険 at its payment. 所得税法 §186 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033): a 賞与 is withheld by the bonus rate table (INCOME_TAX_BONUS), not the monthly table.

name: 食事の現物支給 (meals provided, monthly value)
authority: 所得税法 §36; 所得税基本通達 36-38の2 (https://www.nta.go.jp/users/gensen/2026shokuji/index.htm; https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2594.htm): the month’s value (before consumption tax) of meals the employer provides. INCOME_TAX leaves it untaxed where the worker pays at least half (MEAL_CHARGE) and the value less the charge is at most JPY3,500 (JPY7,500 for meals provided from 1 April 2026); otherwise the value less the charge is pay. Destination DISPLAY: never paid. The 社会保険・労働保険 in-kind valuation (告示 prices) is not this entry.

name: 食事代の本人負担 (worker’s meal charge)

authority: 所得税法 §30(1) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033): 退職手当、一時恩給その他の退職により一時に受ける給与 — taxed apart as 退職所得 (RETIREMENT_INCOME_TAX) and by the 退職所得割 (RESIDENT_TAX_RETIREMENT, 地方税法 §50-2, §328); it may fund an exit lump collection of the monthly resident tax (地方税法 §321-5(2)). authority: 労働基準法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049) §26: for a shutdown attributable to the employer, at least 60% of the 平均賃金 for each day of it; where part of a day was worked and paid, the difference up to that 60%. 平均賃金 (労働基準法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049) §12): the wages of the three calendar months before the event’s month over their calendar days, the §12(3) maternity, childcare and family-care leave spans and their wages left out; bonuses and one-off pay are not in the wage total (§12(4)). Kanagawa Labour Bureau (https://jsite.mhlw.go.jp/kanagawa-roudoukyoku/hourei_seido_tetsuzuki/saiteichingin_chinginseido/heikinchi.html): the average drops the fraction below one sen; the payment rounds to the yen, 50 sen and over up. Where the payslips cannot state it — the §12(1) 60% floor for day, hour or piece pay, a trial period, a work-injury or earlier shutdown period, a closing day other than month end, under three months’ service — the request records the computed 平均賃金 as average_wage. The allowance is 賃金: it bears 雇用保険 and 労災保険 (Kanagawa Labour Bureau 労働保険料の算定基礎となる賃金早見表 (https://jsite.mhlw.go.jp/kanagawa-roudoukyoku/hourei_seido_tetsuzuki/roudou_hoken/hourei_seido/rouho_hayami.html)) and is 給与 for 所得税法 §28(1) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033). An agreed amount above the floor (entry.amount) stands.

name: 解雇予告手当 (pay in lieu of dismissal notice)
authority: 労働基準法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049) §20(1)–(2): a dismissal needs 30 days’ notice or 30 days’ 平均賃金, the notice shortened by a day for each day’s 平均賃金 paid — (30 − the notice days given) × the average; §20(1) ただし書 and §21 exemptions (inspector-certified disaster or worker fault; day hires, short fixed terms, seasonal work, probation within 14 days) are HR’s decision not to raise the request. 平均賃金 (労働基準法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049) §12): the wages of the three calendar months before the event’s month over their calendar days, the §12(3) maternity, childcare and family-care leave spans and their wages left out; bonuses and one-off pay are not in the wage total (§12(4)). Kanagawa Labour Bureau (https://jsite.mhlw.go.jp/kanagawa-roudoukyoku/hourei_seido_tetsuzuki/saiteichingin_chinginseido/heikinchi.html): the average drops the fraction below one sen; the payment rounds to the yen, 50 sen and over up. Where the payslips cannot state it — the §12(1) 60% floor for day, hour or piece pay, a trial period, a work-injury or earlier shutdown period, a closing day other than month end, under three months’ service — the request records the computed 平均賃金 as average_wage. The allowance is not 賃金 for labour insurance (Kanagawa Labour Bureau 労働保険料の算定基礎となる賃金早見表 (https://jsite.mhlw.go.jp/kanagawa-roudoukyoku/hourei_seido_tetsuzuki/roudou_hoken/hourei_seido/rouho_hayami.html)) and is a 退職手当等 for income tax (所得税基本通達 30-5, https://www.nta.go.jp/law/tsutatsu/kihon/shotoku/04/04.htm), so it counts as the RETIREMENT_ALLOWANCE does. An agreed amount above the floor (entry.amount) stands.
